All that's left is "Tyrant." Let's go.

Yeah...!!
I can feel tremendous pressure...
Ride Machine, full speed ahead!!

...Well, one thing's for sure: it's not a plan that's good news for us.

Turtle's in charge of it! I'm gonna go tease him later~!

Yeah, of course.
Of course. Well then, I'll head back ahead of you.

Black King is no mere savage monster! It's been drilled with all your data!!
So you are warriors of some skill, it seems...
Heh, my evolution is only just getting started, you know?
Wail! Writhe in frustration! Gaaaraaaah!!
Now it's getting fun. This is war, y'know? And on one hell of a scale!!
